name: Past Experiences
overview: Scripture reveals that past experiences, including affliction and sorrow, serve a divine purpose in refining the believer's heart and deepening their understanding of God's statutes, as seen in Psalms 119:71 and Ecclesiastes 7:3. While Isaiah 43:18 encourages believers to not dwell on former things, the Lord remains a steadfast refuge in times of trouble (Nahum 1:7), offering mercy even amidst judgment (Habakkuk 3:2). Ultimately, Jesus promises abundant life beyond the trials shaped by past experiences, emphasizing His purpose to bring life rather than destruction (John 10:10).
